label: Naming standards: tables, documents, exceptions, settings

params.name: exception_marker
params.label: The line that starts a documented exception in README.md / ARCHITECTURE.md

params.name: exception_fields
params.label: Fields every documented exception fills (after '# EXCEPTION: <what>')

params.name: exception_files
params.label: Where a portal writes its exceptions

params.name: name_pattern
params.label: A table or column name: snake_case, lower case

params.name: plural_endings
params.label: A table name's last word ends with one of these (plural)

params.name: singular_suffixes
params.label: Fixed category words a table may end with, in the singular (an audit_log, a pipeline_config)

params.name: banned_suffixes
params.label: Plural forms of the fixed words - never

params.name: banned_prefixes
params.label: Abbreviated prefixes - spell the word out

params.name: pk_name
params.label: A table's own single-column primary key

params.name: fk_suffix
params.label: A column that refers to another table: <singular table>_id

params.name: singular_rules
params.label: How a plural table name becomes singular (ending -> ending), first match wins

params.name: bool_types
params.label: Column types that are yes / no

params.name: bool_prefixes
params.label: A yes / no column starts with one of these

params.name: backup_pattern
params.label: A snapshot table: _backup_<project>_<YYYYMMDD>_<table>

params.name: backup_keep_days
params.label: A snapshot table older than this many days is reported for deletion

params.name: db_known
default: agents: trig: no single-column primary key
params.label: Names made before the rule (2026-11-12) - this list only shrinks; a new table follows the rule

params.name: doc_pattern
params.label: A document's file name: <project>-<topic_words>-vM_m.md or -YYYYMMDD.md

params.name: doc_exempt
params.label: Well-known names tools and people look for - kept as they are

params.name: doc_kinds
params.label: The last topic word says what kind of document it is

params.name: doc_folders
params.label: Folders whose .md files follow the document naming rule

params.name: doc_archive
params.label: Where a superseded edition goes (inside the docs folder), with a STATUS: SUPERSEDED banner

params.name: env_file
params.label: The file that lists every setting the server reads from its environment (names only)

params.name: env_ignore
params.label: System variables a portal reads but never sets

params.name: scan_skip
params.label: scan skip

params.name: check_words

default.db_new: a table or column breaks the naming standard (chip standards.naming; plural snake_case, id, <entity>_id, is_, _log singular):
default.db_gone: fixed - take these out of chip standards.naming db_known (the list only shrinks):
default.docs: a document's file name breaks the naming standard (chip standards.naming doc_pattern):
default.exc: a documented exception is not filled in (chip standards.naming exception_fields):
default.env: a setting the code reads is not listed:
default.lock_behind: requirements.lock is behind requirements.txt - run python tools/lock_deps.py:
default.deploy_unhashed: deploy.sh does not install from the lock by its hashes (chip deps.lock install_line)
default.ok: standards: tables named to the standard ({known} older names waiting), documents named, exceptions filled, every setting in {env_file} OK
default.no_rehash: an older password hash was not re-made at sign-in (chip auth.limits hash_rounds)
default.no_request_id: an answer has no request id (chip log.settings)
default.id_not_kept: a caller's request id was not kept (chip log.settings id_pattern)

params.label: check words

description_nl: 2026-11-12 owner ("Yes, A and B" on the VS standards review): one chip for the naming rules core/standards.py checks - database tables and columns (four kinds of data, plural snake_case, id / <entity>_id / is_, _log singular, config spelled out, dated snapshots), document file names (<project>-<topic_words>-vM_m / -YYYYMMDD, a kind word last, a new version replaces the old in full), documented exceptions and the .env.example list. db_known is a ratchet: names from before the rule, only ever removed.

db_known: agents: trig: no single-column primary key
